statuses.excluded: Deliberately out of scope for Caddy: build123d machinery (builder contexts, Python-only plumbing, visualisation helpers) with no TypeScript counterpart.
statuses.planned: In scope and specified here, but not implemented in Caddy yet.
statuses.implemented: Caddy code exists and type-checks; behaviour not yet compared against build123d.
statuses.tested: Covered by Caddy unit tests, but not differentially compared against build123d.
statuses.validated: Differentially validated against build123d 0.13.0 / OCCT 8.0.1 fixtures within documented tolerances.

capabilities.geometry: Vectors, axes, planes, locations, matrices, bounding boxes, colors, units.
capabilities.primitives-3d: Parametric solid primitives and hole features.
capabilities.curves: Parametric edge/wire constructors and curve geometry.
capabilities.operations: Modelling operations: boolean, fillet/chamfer, extrude, revolve, loft, sweep, offset, split, project.
capabilities.selectors: ShapeList construction, filtering, sorting and grouping.
capabilities.drafting: Dimension lines, extension lines, title blocks and annotation.
capabilities.misc: Everything else: units, packing, helpers, builder-only machinery.

conventions.classes: Caddy keeps the build123d class names (Box, Vector, Plane, ShapeList, ...).
conventions.members: Methods and properties become camelCase; `#` marks an instance member and `.` a static member (e.g. `Shape#fillet`, `Solid.makeBox`).
conventions.operators: Python operators become named methods: `+`->union, `-`->subtract, `&`->intersect, `Location*Shape`->`Location#transform`/`Shape#moved`, `@`->positionAt, `%`->tangentAt, `^`->locationAt, ShapeList `>>`/`<<`->`groupBy(...).last`/`.first`, `|`->filterBy.
conventions.enums: Enums become TypeScript const objects whose members are PascalCase (`Align.Center`, `GeomType.Line`, `SortBy.Area`).
conventions.free-functions: build123d `operations_*` free functions map to a Caddy shape method where natural (`Shape#fillet`, `Face#extrude`) and keep an exported function form for list/multi-object use (`fillet`, `loft`, `sweep`, `extrude`).
conventions.io: `import_step`/`import_brep`/... become `importStep`/`importBrep` (plus the format-sniffing `importCAD`); every `export_*` becomes `export(shape, { name, type: CADFileType.Step })`.
conventions.mixins: Mixin1D/Mixin2D/Mixin3D are build123d's shared bases for 1D/2D/3D shapes; their members are listed once here and are inherited by Edge/Wire, Face/Shell and Solid/Compound respectively.
